criteria.description: States the objective of adding an executable bit-exact CAN codec model in `modules.tools.gen_vehicle_protocol.frame_codec`.

States that generated output for accepted signals must remain unchanged.

States that `extract_dbc_meta.py` removes the `if var_info["len"] <= 32` filter.
Names `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/BUILD` as adding an `apollo_py_binary` target named `frame_codec`.
Records that the agent inferred `Byte::get_byte` semantics from `modules/drivers/canbus/common/byte.cc` without full un-truncated verification.
Records that the agent inferred `Byte::set_value` semantics from `modules/drivers/canbus/common/byte.cc` without full un-truncated verification.
Names `modules/drivers/canbus/can_comm/protocol_data.h` as defining the `ProtocolData::BoundedValue` clamping semantics.
Names `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/apollo_demo.dbc` as having all signals in motorola `@0+` order.
Names `modules/canbus_vehicle/demo/proto/demo.proto` as containing `optional int32 vin15 = 1;`.
Specifies `filter_protocol_vars(protocol)` in `frame_codec.py` as returning `(supported_vars, skipped_names)`.
Records that `VIN15 : 63|16` in `vin_resp2` yields byte 8.
Records that `modules/canbus_vehicle/demo/protocol/throttle_command_100.cc` slices `Speed_Target : 47|12@0+` as `[(5,0,8),(6,4,4)]`.
Names `gen_proto_file.py` as an emission stage to re-plumb with `filter_protocol_vars`.
Specifies that `signal_layout` raises `UnsupportedSignalError` when `signal["len"] > 32`.
Records that `FrameCodec.quantize` writes only one signal onto an all-zero `dlc` frame rather than using full `encode`, because other signals' defaults can have nonzero raw values.
Records that non-`motorola` byte order falls through to the `intel` path, mirroring `gen_protocols.py::get_byte_info`'s `else` branch.
Records that `SignalLayout` uses `__slots__` with read-only `slices` and `bit_width` properties so rebinding raises `AttributeError`.
Records that clamping in `FrameCodec.encode` applies only to non-enum and non-bool types, mirroring C++ `BoundedValue`.
Records that `gen_canbus_conf.py` is left untouched because it does not iterate `vars`.
Records that the `if var["len"] > 32` block in `gen_protocols.py` is planned to be removed.
Records that `int32_t` overflow of the C++ accumulator is out of scope for `FrameCodec` agreement.
Records that `gen_protocols.py` plans to import `filter_protocol_vars` using `from modules.tools.gen_vehicle_protocol.frame_codec import filter_protocol_vars`, matching `gen.py`.
Records that the agent noted an unverified hypothesis of a `black_list` `KeyError` on `protocol["vars"]` in `extract_dbc_meta.py`.
Records that `UnsupportedSignalError.__init__(signal_name, message=None)` provides a default error message when `message` is `None`.

Specifies wiring `filter_protocol_vars` into `gen_vehicle_controller_and_manager.py` as a pending step.
Specifies sanity-testing `FrameCodec.decode` round-trips against the generated C++ logic as a pending verification step.

Contains at most 18600 characters.
